description: A faint, straight ditch or canal segment, approximately 120 m long and 3–4 m wide, trending north–south. In the multi‐azimuth hillshade it appears as a low‐relief concave line cutting across a gentle slope (<2°), with matching moisture anomaly in the NIR band (slightly elevated reflectance suggesting trapped subcanopy moisture). Likely part of an upland drainage network.

Cluster of three small, regularly spaced platforms (~20–30 m across each) forming a roughly rectangular block. In plan they present as flat‐topped ridges on low‐relief convex plan‐curvature zones, matching known Terra Preta field platforms. Subtle dark‐earth moisture signature in NIR, absent on OSM.
